freeze.code_baseline_rule: No learning-flow, question, answer-key, storage-schema or gate-policy changes after this baseline except a critical exam-blocking hotfix.

exam_behavior.wrong_retention: Any once-wrong question remains historical evidence even after later mastery.
exam_behavior.pre_chapter_gate: Before Day2-18, up to three historical wrongs from earlier Days can be resurfaced.
exam_behavior.repeat_wrong: Do not reveal answer/explanation first; require textbook-location lookup and same-question retry.
exam_behavior.day1_to_day6_locator: Use audited exact page/question mapping from QUESTION_SOURCE_MAPPING_AUDIT.json where verified.
exam_behavior.day7_to_day18_locator: Never invent a page; use verified unit/chapter/section guidance when exact page is unavailable.
exam_behavior.refresh_back_resilience: Mandatory textbook lookup persists across refresh/back/re-entry after a repeated wrong.
exam_behavior.direct_url_resilience: Normal direct Day URL entry cannot bypass the required prior-wrong gate.
exam_behavior.firebase_merge_resilience: Permanent wrong records normalize status from timestamp invariants after reconciliation.

qa.stage1_integrated_flow: passed with fixes by static/runtime-code analysis
qa.stage2_release_hardening: passed with fixes by static/runtime-code analysis
qa.visual_clickthrough_limitation: A learner browser carrying the actual localStorage/Firebase state was not available in this environment, so real visual click-through is not claimed.

known_non_blocking_item.item: esc() uses &quot without a semicolon for double-quote HTML entity.
known_non_blocking_item.decision: Accepted for Exam Release 1.0 because it is low risk and not exam-blocking; do not reopen the frozen engine solely for this cleanup.

deployment.release_commit: the commit created by this CURRENT_RELEASE_STATE.json freeze update
deployment.required_final_verification: GitHub Pages build for the frozen release commit must be status=built and error.message=null before changing release status to confirmed.

recovery.policy: If a critical exam hotfix is required, branch conceptually from the frozen release and change only the blocking defect; do not refactor unrelated code.

post_freeze_policy: Only critical exam-blocking hotfixes are permitted until the exam deployment is retired.
local_sync_note: GitHub Desktop should only Pull origin. Do not Commit or Push stale local files.
backup_rule: GitHub main is source of truth. Do not create a full ZIP unless explicitly requested.
